articles.title_en: Consumption heterogeneity and monetary policy in an open economy
articles.title_cn: 开放经济中的消费异质性与货币政策
articles.abstract_en: We incorporate two types of agents (Ricardian versus Keynesian) into a standard open economy macro model. We find that consumption heterogeneity has major implications for the impact of monetary policy shocks, the international transmission mechanism, and the design of optimal monetary policy. With sticky prices, the existence of Keynesian agents causes a spillover of shocks across countries, and leads to the interdependence of optimal monetary targeting rules. In the case of local currency pricing, consumer heterogeneity leads an optimal monetary policy to generate currency misalignment and deviations from the law of one price. Theoretically, there are ranges of household heterogeneity in which monetary policy becomes ineffective, but this depends sensitively on the interaction of aggregate demand and relative price effects.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们将两类代理人（李嘉图型与凯恩斯型）纳入一个标准的开放经济宏观模型。我们发现，消费异质性对货币政策冲击的影响、国际传导机制以及最优货币政策的设计具有重要含义。在价格粘性条件下，凯恩斯型代理人的存在导致冲击在国家间的溢出，并引起最优货币盯住规则的相互依赖。在本地货币定价的情况下，消费者异质性导致最优货币政策产生货币错位和背离一价定律。理论上，存在家庭异质性范围使得货币政策失效，但这取决于总需求与相对价格效应的相互作用。}

articles.title_en: The effectiveness of a negative interest rate policy
articles.abstract_en: In a dynamic stochastic general equilibrium model that is calibrated for the euro area, a negative interest rate policy (NIRP) can have contractionary effects on the economy when interest rates on household deposits reach the zero lower bound, and such deposits are the only source of bank funding and household savings. However, by introducing additional assets to households’ portfolios and alternative sources of bank funding, such as bank bonds, the NIRP becomes expansionary. Because both features characterize the euro area well, they are essential to study the effectiveness of NIRP policies.
articles.abstract_cn: 在一个针对欧元区校准的动态随机一般均衡模型中，当家庭存款利率达到零下限，且此类存款是银行融资和家庭储蓄的唯一来源时，负利率政策（NIRP）可能对经济产生紧缩效应。然而，通过向家庭投资组合引入额外资产以及银行融资的替代来源（如银行债券），负利率政策变得具有扩张性。由于这两个特征都很好地描述了欧元区的情况，它们对于研究负利率政策的有效性至关重要。

articles.title_en: Health versus wealth: On the distributional effects of controlling a pandemic
articles.title_cn: 健康还是财富：控制大流行的分配效应
articles.abstract_en: To slow the COVID-19 virus, many countries shut down parts of the economy. Older individuals have the most to gain from slowing virus diffusion. Younger workers in shuttered sectors have most to lose. We build a model in which economic activity and disease progression are jointly determined. Individuals differ by age, sector and health status. Disease transmission occurs at work, at home, through consumption, and in hospitals. Optimal economic shutdowns in 2020 are milder when taxes are distortionary, and when the government does not have access to debt. A harder, shorter shutdown is preferred when vaccines become available in early 2021.
articles.abstract_cn: 为了减缓COVID-19病毒的传播，许多国家关闭了部分经济部门。老年人从减缓病毒传播中获益最多。在关闭部门工作的年轻工人损失最大。我们构建了一个经济活动与疾病进展共同决定的模型。个体按年龄、部门和健康状况区分。疾病传播发生在工作场所、家庭、消费过程中以及医院。当税收具有扭曲性且政府无法获得债务时，2020年的最优经济关闭程度较为温和。当疫苗在2021年初可用时，更严格、更短暂的关闭更受青睐。

articles.title_en: Uncertainty, imperfect information, and expectation formation over the firm’s life cycle
articles.title_cn: 不确定性、不完全信息与企业生命周期中的预期形成
articles.abstract_en: Using a long panel data set on Japanese firms, we find that firms make more precise forecasts and less autocorrelated forecast errors as they gain more experience. Then, we build a firm dynamics model where firms gradually learn about their demand by using a noisy signal. Using expectations data over time, we cleanly isolate the learning mechanism from other mechanisms and find that it accounts for 20%–40% of the overall decline in forecast errors over the life cycle. Productivity gains from removing information frictions range from 3% to 12%, with firm entry and exit playing prominent roles.
articles.abstract_cn: 利用日本企业的长面板数据集，我们发现随着企业获得更多经验，它们做出的预测更为精确，预测误差的自相关性也更低。然后，我们构建了一个企业动态模型，在该模型中，企业通过使用噪声信号逐渐了解其需求。利用随时间变化的预期数据，我们清晰地隔离了学习机制与其他机制，并发现学习机制解释了生命周期中预测误差总体下降的20%–40%。消除信息摩擦带来的生产率收益在3%到12%之间，其中企业进入和退出扮演着重要角色。

articles.title_en: Long-lived employment effects of delays in emergency financing for small businesses
articles.title_cn: 小企业紧急融资延迟对就业的长期影响
articles.abstract_en: Delays in the provision of loans under Paycheck Protection Program due to the rapid exhaustion of initial funding had a large and persistent negative effect on employment. We estimate that increasing the size of the initial PPP funding by 10 percent could have increased employment by over 2 million jobs through the summer of 2020 and more than 1 million jobs through the fall. The implied costs per job saved are low for a stimulus program, while our effect sizes are in line with recent estimates of the effects of payment timing and the costs of external financing for small businesses. In addition, the smallest firms were most likely to face delay and we find suggestive evidence that the costs of delay were more acute for workers in these firms and for the self-employed. Heterogeneous effects are consistent with these borrowers facing greater difficulty in obtaining alternative financing and suggests that a more targeted program could have achieved even greater efficacy.
articles.abstract_cn: 由于初始资金迅速耗尽，薪资保护计划下贷款发放的延迟对就业产生了巨大而持续的负面影响。我们估计，将初始PPP资金规模增加10%，到2年夏季可能增加超过2020万个就业岗位，到秋季则增加超过1万个。对于刺激计划而言，每个工作岗位的隐含成本较低，而我们的效应大小与近期关于支付时点效应和小企业外部融资成本的估计一致。此外，最小的企业最可能面临延迟，我们发现有提示性证据表明，延迟对这些企业中的工人和自雇者的成本更为严重。异质性效应与这些借款人在获得替代融资方面面临更大困难的情况一致，并表明更具针对性的计划本可以实现更高的效率。

articles.title_en: The economic effects of firm-level uncertainty: Evidence using subjective expectations
articles.title_cn: 企业层面不确定性的经济效应：基于主观预期的证据
articles.abstract_en: Using two decades of Italian survey data on business managers’ expectations we measure subjective firm-level uncertainty and quantify its economic effects. Firm-level uncertainty persists for a few years and varies across firms’ demographic characteristics. Uncertainty induces sizable and long-lasting economic effects over a broad array of real and financial variables only when driven by its downside component — that is, uncertainty about below-mean outcomes. Economy-wide uncertainty, constructed by aggregating firm-level uncertainty, is countercyclical but uncorrelated with typical proxies in the literature.
articles.abstract_cn: 利用意大利商业管理者预期的二十年调查数据，我们衡量了主观企业层面的不确定性并量化了其经济效应。企业层面的不确定性持续数年，并随企业人口特征而变化。只有当不确定性由其下行部分——即对低于均值结果的不确定性——驱动时，才会对广泛的实体和金融变量产生显著且持久的经济效应。通过汇总企业层面不确定性构建的总体不确定性是逆周期的，但与文献中的典型代理变量不相关。

articles.title_en: The long-run redistributive effects of monetary policy
articles.title_cn: 货币政策的长期再分配效应
articles.abstract_en: Using a general equilibrium search-theoretic model of money, I study the long-run distributional effects of monetary policy. In my model, heterogeneous agents trade bilaterally in a frictional market and save using cash and illiquid short-term nominal government bonds. Wealth effects generate slow adjustments in agents’ portfolios following their trading activity in decentralized markets, giving rise to a persistent and non-degenerate distribution of assets. The model reproduces the distribution of asset levels and portfolios across households observed in the data. I show that, as wealth inequality increases the incidence of inefficiencies in decentralized trading, policies that improve the ability to self-insure against idiosyncratic shocks are welfare-improving and redistribute resources towards agents that are relatively poor and more liquidity constrained.
articles.abstract_cn: 利用货币的一般均衡搜索理论模型，我研究了货币政策的长期分配效应。在我的模型中，异质性代理人在摩擦市场中双边交易，并使用现金和非流动性短期名义政府债券进行储蓄。财富效应导致代理人投资组合在去中心化市场交易活动后缓慢调整，从而产生持久且非退化的资产分布。该模型再现了数据中观察到的家庭资产水平和投资组合分布。我表明，随着财富不平等加剧去中心化交易中低效率的发生率，提高抵御特质冲击能力的政策能够改善福利，并将资源重新分配给相对贫困且流动性约束更强的代理人。

articles.title_en: Identifying sectoral shocks and their role in business cycles
articles.title_cn: 识别部门冲击及其在商业周期中的作用
articles.abstract_en: US business cycles can be empirically characterized as a time-varying mix of different sectoral shocks. Sectoral shocks are distinct from aggregate shocks and better capture business cycle fluctuations. A typical recession (or boom) is interpreted as the combination of a few sectoral shocks, which encompass more diverse origins than the typical narrative prevalent for that recession. Sectoral shocks have aggregate consequences through strong input–output network effects. Identification is based on network-implied heterogeneity restrictions in a FAVAR framework and far less dependent on specific DSGE calibrations compared to previous work.
articles.abstract_cn: 美国商业周期可以被经验性地描述为不同部门冲击的时变组合。部门冲击不同于总体冲击，更能捕捉商业周期波动。典型的衰退（或繁荣）被解释为少数部门冲击的组合，这些冲击包含的起源比该衰退时期普遍存在的典型叙述更为多样。部门冲击通过强大的投入产出网络效应产生总体后果。识别基于FAVAR框架中网络隐含的异质性限制，与以往工作相比，对特定DSGE校准的依赖程度大大降低。
